function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the local filesystem and return its contents with line numbers (cat -n style). Optionally read a slice with offset/limit.

target_file.description: Absolute path, or path relative to the workspace root, of the file to read.

offset.description: 1-based line number to start from. Optional.

limit.description: Max number of lines to read. Optional.
